name: OD Fit Pipeline
description: On a timer, reads the stored operator ephemerides ($OEM records, typed storage.query) and fits SGP4 supplemental-GP mean elements per object with analysis/od's fitter, emitting $OMM and $OBD records (analysis/od's builders). Provider set, per-provider fit policy and the object-ID registry are node config (plugin.getConfig). Records that cannot be fitted (unsupported frame/time/center, unreadable, too few samples, non-converged) are FlowNotices with the reason; storing and publishing the fits is the flow's (hostcap/storage-ingest).

timers.description: Periodic OD fit pass over stored OEM records (default every 2h, matching CelesTrak's 2h SupGP regeneration cadence - no value in re-fitting more often than the source ephemerides refresh).

methods.displayName: Fit SupGP $OMM from stored operator ephemerides
methods.description: One pass: storage.query(querySchema, queryLimit) -> per record, group by SOURCE_NAME to a configured provider, read the $OEM (analysis/od's reader: TEME / EME2000-J2000-GCRF / Earth-fixed frames, UTC/GPS/TAI, EARTH only), fit (od::fit_sgp4_series with the provider's maxIterations, fitWindowSec, subsample, convergenceTol) and emit $OMM + $OBD; skips and a per-provider summary are FlowNotices.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK); FIRED_MS stamps the notices.

inputPorts.description: The od-fit-pull timer tick; a direct invoke needs none.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Fitted supplemental-GP elements, carried as an aligned-binary frame containing a size-prefixed SDS OMM.

outputPorts.description: One size-prefixed SDS $OMM per fitted object (analysis/od's builder, ORIGINATOR SDN-OD).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The fit's OD run results, aligned-binary frames containing a size-prefixed SDS OBD.

outputPorts.description: One $OBD per fitted object, in the order of the omm records (METHOD DIFFERENTIAL_CORRECTION, METHOD_SOURCE SDN-OD: WRMS = position RMS km, NUM_ITERATIONS, FIT_SPAN days; SENSORS[0].SENSOR_ID = the provider's dataSource).

Skipped: one per record not fitted (SOURCE_NAME the provider, PROVIDER_ID the record's, ITEMS [its CID], REASON the cause: <reader error code>: <message>, too-few-samples:<n>, <norad>:fit-not-converged:rms=<km>, fit-failed: <message>), and one for the records of no configured provider (REASON unconfigured, ITEMS their CIDs). Info: one summary per provider (COUNT records fitted, ITEMS their CIDs in the order of the omm records). Missing: storage.query failed (REASON storage-query-failed: <message>).

sequentialJustification.detail: One pass reads the stored ephemerides and fits each object in turn with sequential differential correction; it starts no workers. Passes over other stores run in other host instances.
